name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window eliminates truncation on long documents, cutting a known failure mode that costs us 0.5–1% accuracy in legal review tasks. The trade-off is higher compute cost per query, but we gain 3–4x faster turnaround on large contracts versus our current model, offsetting the expense. The artifact is the updated model config in EXCAVA’s API layer.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s compute cost isn’t a rounding error—it’s a 3–4x jump in our budget burn rate, and legal review tasks don’t need 128K context for 95% of cases. Llama3.2-3B-Instruct’s 128K window is untested but would cut cost 10x while solving truncation for the remaining 5%. Run a side-by-side on 100 long contracts; if the 3B model’s accuracy loss is <0.3%, it’s the better trade.
